title: A small local museum and its surroundings in 1957 and 2007
prompt: The diagram below shows a small local museum and its surroundings in 1957 and 2007. Summarize the information and make comparisons where relevant.
guideHtml:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

Museum (1957 vs 2007)

1. Giải thích đề

Sơ đồ cho thấy sự thay đổi của một bảo tàng trong giai đoạn từ 1957 đến 2007.

→ Dạng: map – changes over time

2. Introduction (paraphrase)

Giữ: museum – 1957 – 2007

Dùng:

  • shows → illustrates / compares
  • changes → developments / transformations

3. Overview (ý chính)

  • Bảo tàng được mở rộng và hiện đại hóa rõ rệt
  • Không gian bên trong được tái bố trí hoàn toàn
  • Thêm nhiều khu chức năng mới (café, education centre, special exhibitions)
  • Bên ngoài xuất hiện car park, trong khi garden bị thu hẹp

4. Chia BODY

BODY 1 – Bên trong bảo tàng
  • Năm 1957:
  • National history exhibition chiếm phần lớn diện tích
  • Hai phòng nhỏ:
  • Local history room
  • Museum store room
  • Có entrance hall ở trung tâm
  • Năm 2007:
  • Không còn national history exhibition
  • Thêm:
  • Special exhibitions
  • Education centre
  • Café
  • Local history room được giữ nhưng đặt ở trung tâm
  • Reception thay thế entrance hall

→ Ý: chuyển từ trưng bày đơn giản → đa chức năng, phục vụ khách tham quan

BODY 2 – Khu bên ngoài
  • Năm 1957:
  • Có garden lớn phía trước
  • Không có bãi đỗ xe
  • Năm 2007:
  • Car park được xây phía trước (gần road)
  • Garden bị thu hẹp
  • Entrance chuyển sang bên trái

→ Ý: ưu tiên tiện ích và khả năng tiếp cận

5. Gợi ý từ vựng

  • be redesigned → được thiết kế lại
  • be replaced by → được thay thế
  • be converted into → được chuyển thành
  • be expanded → được mở rộng
  • be reduced → bị thu hẹp
  • visitor facilities → tiện ích cho khách tham quan
sampleHtml:
The diagrams compare the layout of a museum in 1957 and 2007.

Overall, the museum was expanded and modernised, with more facilities added and the internal layout reorganised. Notably, new exhibition spaces, an education centre, and a café were introduced.

In 1957, the museum had a simple structure, with a large national history exhibition occupying most of the building. Inside it, there were two smaller rooms: a local history room on the left and a museum store room on the right. The entrance hall was located at the front, facing a road, while a garden surrounded the building.

By 2007, the building had been extended and redesigned. The entrance was moved to the left side, leading to a reception area in the centre. The local history room remained but was relocated to the middle of the museum. New facilities, including a special exhibitions area and an education centre, were added at the top, while a café was introduced on the right. The former store room was replaced by a museum room. In addition, a car park was constructed in front of the building, replacing part of the garden.
chartDescription:
TYPE: map/plan
TITLE: Museum 1957 / Museum 2007
UNITS/AXES: Not applicable. Compass rose with N, W, E, S.
SERIES/CATEGORIES:
Museum 1957: National history exhibition, Local history room, Museum store room, Entrance hall, Road, Garden.
Museum 2007: Special exhibitions, Education centre, Local history room, Museum room, Reception, Café, Entrance, Car park, Road, Garden.
Legend: Exhibition / public areas (dark blue), Rooms / facilities (grey), Entrance / doors (pink), Garden / trees (green tree icon), Building (light yellow), Road / car park (dark grey).

DATA:
Museum 1957:
- Building: Large light yellow structure.
- National history exhibition: Occupies the main central and eastern part of the building.
- Local history room: Located in the northwest part of the building, within the national history exhibition area.
- Museum store room: Located in the northeast part of the building, within the national history exhibition area.
- Entrance hall: A pink rectangular area in the south-central part of the building, leading to the national history exhibition.
- Road: Runs along the southern edge of the map.
- Entrance to museum: A path from the road leads to the entrance hall.
- Garden: Located to the west of the building, with three trees.
- Trees: A row of nine trees lines the road to the west of the entrance path, and another row of five trees lines the road to the east of the entrance path.

Museum 2007:
- Building: Expanded light yellow structure, now L-shaped.
- Special exhibitions: Located in the north-central part of the building.
- Education centre: Located in the northeast part of the building.
- Local history room: Now a central area within the building, south of special exhibitions and education centre.
- Museum room: Located in the southwest part of the building.
- Reception: Located in the central part of the building, south of the local history room and east of the museum room.
- Café: Located in the southeast part of the building.
- Entrance: A pink rectangular area in the south-central part of the building, leading into the museum room.
- Road: Runs along the southern edge of the map.
- Car park: Located between the road and the building, to the east of the entrance.
- Garden: Located to the west of the building, with three trees.

KEY FEATURES:
- The museum building was significantly expanded and reconfigured between 1957 and 2007.
- The entrance to the museum was moved from the south-central part of the original building to the southwest corner of the expanded building.
- The "National history exhibition" and "Museum store room" were removed.
- New facilities added include "Special exhibitions", "Education centre", "Reception", "Café", and a "Car park".
- The "Local history room" was retained but its location and size within the building changed.
- The garden area with three trees to the west of the building remained unchanged, but the rows of trees along the road were removed.
